schedule.title: Schedule and publish
schedule.intro: Set the time and the place, then publish. What the proposer wrote carries over as it is — there is nothing to retype.

startsAt.label: Date and time
startsAt.hint: In the venue's time zone, not your device's.

duration.label: Duration in minutes
duration.fromProposal: From the proposal: {count, plural, one {{value} minute} other {{value} minutes}}

ends.followsEmpty: The end is worked out from the start and the duration.
ends.label: End of the session
ends.hint: An end you set yourself stays put and stops following the duration.
ends.follow: Work it out from the duration

days.switchHint: Each day has its own check-in, its own materials and its own preparation tasks.
days.locked: Someone checked in on this day, so it cannot be removed.
days.samePlace: Same place as the day before: {name}
days.placeNote: This is the first day's place, and every day after it inherits the place until you change that day.

confirm.oneNote: Nothing but the date itself is removed.
confirm.promotes: {count, plural, one {This day's item moves to the whole session; it is not deleted.} other {This day's {value} items move to the whole session; they are not deleted.}}
confirm.allNote: {count, plural, one {One day is removed, and its materials move to the whole session.} other {{value} days are removed, and their materials move to the whole session.}}

venue.label: Venue
venue.option: {name} · {count, plural, =0 {no set capacity} one {{value} seat} other {{value} seats}}
venue.customHint: A one-off place is not added to your organisation's list.

capacity.label: Capacity
capacity.hint: The number of seats open to booking.
capacity.fromVenue: From the venue's capacity: {count, plural, one {{value} seat} other {{value} seats}}

walkIns.label: Allow walk-in attendance
walkIns.hint: Off by default: the check-in code is accepted only from a confirmed reservation. Decided here only, when the session is scheduled or edited.

requireAllDays.label: Points and the certificate after every day
requireAllDays.hint: Awarded once, for the whole session. Turn it off and attending one day is enough.

language.hint: The language of the room, not of the interface.

presenters.title: Presenters
presenters.none: Nobody has been assigned to present this session yet.
presenters.onlyOne: A session always keeps at least one presenter, so the last one cannot be removed.
presenters.completedNote: This session has completed: someone you add earns the presenter points, and someone you remove loses theirs through a reversing entry.
presenters.addHint: They are notified that the session has been assigned to them.
presenters.removeConfirmBody: Their name will no longer appear among this session's presenters.
presenters.removeConfirmBodyCompleted: Their name will no longer appear among this session's presenters, and their presenter points are reversed.

errors.presenter_not_in_org: This member is not in your organisation.
errors.too_many_presenters: This session has reached the maximum number of presenters.
errors.presenter_not_found: This member is no longer a presenter.
errors.last_presenter: The last presenter of a session cannot be removed. Add someone else first.
errors.not_an_admin: Only organisation admins can do this.

actions.publishNote: Publishing notifies every member and opens booking.
actions.editedNote: Everyone booked or waitlisted is told what changed in the time or the place, and their calendars update.

status.published: Published — the session is now visible to members.
